llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了选区激光熔化微支柱的应变率敏感性，但与生物医学植入物的应力遮挡、疲劳或骨整合无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: It does not address biomedical context, stress shielding, stiffness matching, surface roughness, or osseointegration; it focuses only on strain rate sensitivity of micro-struts without specific implant application.

summary_zh.motivation: 表征选区激光熔化微支柱的应变率敏感性。
summary_zh.method: 实验测试不同应变率下SLM微支柱的力学响应。
summary_zh.result: 获得了微支柱的应变率敏感参数。
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学实验验证了应变率效应。

summary_en.motivation: To characterize the strain rate sensitivity of micro-struts fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Experimental testing of SLM micro-struts under various strain rates.
summary_en.result: Strain rate sensitivity parameters were determined for the micro-struts.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing of as-built specimens confirmed strain rate dependence.

llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical implant design, stress shielding, or porous structure; it focuses on process optimization and static mechanical properties of fully dense Ti-6Al-4V.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM+HIP混合工艺对Ti-6Al-4V合金性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 采用选择性激光熔化和热等静压混合工艺制备近净成形Ti-6Al-4V
summary_zh.result: 界面微结构演变和力学性能得到增强
summary_zh.validation: 通过微观表征和力学测试验证

summary_en.motivation: This paper investigates a hybrid selective laser melting and hot isostatic pressing process for near-net shaped Ti-6Al-4V alloy to enhance mechanical properties.
summary_en.method: A novel in-situ tooling was used to combine selective laser melting and hot isostatic pressing for fabricating near-net shaped Ti-6Al-4V components.
summary_en.result: The hybrid process led to improved interfacial microstructure and enhanced mechanical properties compared to conventional SLM.
summary_en.validation: The approach was validated by microstructural analysis (SEM, EBSD) and mechanical testing (tensile, hardness).

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了SLM制备Ti-6Al-4V合金内通道和表面粗糙度对高周疲劳性能的影响，直接关联生物医用植入物的疲劳耐久性。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not explicitly address stress shielding or osseointegration, nor does it evaluate porous structures for stiffness matching.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究内部通道和表面粗糙度对SLM Ti-6Al-4V疲劳寿命的影响。
summary_zh.method: 制备不同内通道几何和表面状态的SLM试样进行高周疲劳测试。
summary_zh.result: 内通道和表面粗糙度显著降低疲劳性能，粗糙表面疲劳寿命下降明显。
summary_zh.validation: 通过高周疲劳实验数据验证内通道和粗糙度的影响规律。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of internal channels and surface roughness on the high-cycle fatigue performance of selective laser melted Ti-6Al-4V, relevant to biomedical implant applications.
summary_en.method: Specimens with varying internal channel geometries and surface conditions were fabricated by SLM and subjected to high-cycle fatigue testing.
summary_en.result: Both internal channels and as-built surface roughness significantly reduced fatigue life, with roughness causing more severe degradation.
summary_en.validation: Experimental fatigue testing validated the detrimental effects of internal channels and surface roughness on fatigue performance.

papers.title: Microscale Architecture in Biomaterial Scaffolds for Spatial Control of Neural Cell Behavior
papers.abstract: Biomaterial scaffolds mimic aspects of the native central nervous system (CNS) extracellular matrix (ECM) and have been extensively utilized to influence neural cell (NC) behavior in in vitro and in vivo settings. These biomimetic scaffolds support NC cultures, can direct the differentiation of NCs, and have recapitulated some native NC behavior in an in vitro setting. However, NC transplant therapies and treatments used in animal models of CNS disease and injury have not fully restored functionality. The observed lack of functional recovery occurs despite improvements in transplanted NC viability when incorporating biomaterial scaffolds and the potential of NC to replace damaged native cells. The behavior of NCs within biomaterial scaffolds must be directed in order to improve the efficacy of transplant therapies and treatments. Biomaterial scaffold topography and imbedded bioactive cues, designed at the microscale level, can alter NC phenotype, direct migration, and differentiation. Microscale patterning in biomaterial scaffolds for spatial control of NC behavior has enhanced the capabilities of in vitro models to capture properties of the native CNS tissue ECM. Patterning techniques such as lithography, electrospinning and 3D bioprinting can be employed to design the microscale architecture of biomaterial scaffolds. Here, the progress and challenges of the prevalent biomaterial patterning techniques of lithography, electrospinning, and 3D bioprinting are reported. This review analyzes NC behavioral response to specific microscale topographical patterns and spatially organized bioactive cues.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该综述讨论了生物材料支架的微结构图案化技术（包括3D生物打印），但未涉及任何人工智能方法，与AI生物打印方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a review of patterning techniques for neural cell scaffolds and contains no AI/ML integration into bioprinting workflow stages.

summary_zh.motivation: 综述生物材料支架微结构图案化技术对神经细胞行为的调控
summary_zh.method: 总结了光刻、静电纺丝和3D生物打印等微图案化方法
summary_zh.result: 指出图案化可改变神经细胞表型、迁移和分化，但功能恢复仍有限
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，为文献综述

summary_en.motivation: To review how microscale topographical patterns and bioactive cues in biomaterial scaffolds can spatially control neural cell behavior.
summary_en.method: The paper reviews three prevalent patterning techniques: lithography, electrospinning, and 3D bioprinting.
summary_en.result: Microscale architectures influence neural cell phenotype, migration, and differentiation, but full functional recovery in vivo remains elusive.
summary_en.validation: This is a review article without original experimental validation.

papers.title: Functional Outcome of Crowe IV Congenital Dysplasia of the Hip Managed by Total Hip Arthroplasty with Subtrochanteric Osteotomy
papers.venue: Journal of Medical Imaging and Health Informatics

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅报告临床结果，未涉及任何生物力学建模或应力遮挡分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify proximal femur stress/strain, micromotion, or provide FE boundary conditions; it is a purely clinical outcome study.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估Crowe IV型髋关节发育不良行全髋置换联合转子下截骨的功能结局。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析该术式患者的临床及影像学数据。
summary_zh.result: 报告术后功能评分和并发症发生率。
summary_zh.validation: 临床随访验证手术效果。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the functional outcome of total hip arthroplasty combined with subtrochanteric osteotomy in Crowe IV developmental dysplasia of the hip.
summary_en.method: A retrospective study analyzing clinical and radiographic data from patients who underwent the procedure.
summary_en.result: Functional scores and complication rates were reported postoperatively.
summary_en.validation: Clinical follow-up was used to validate surgical outcomes.
